title.zh: 面向 E 级系统的大气动力学全隐式模拟局部求解器移植与优化
title.en: Porting and optimizing local solvers for fully implicit atmospheric dynamics simulations on exascale systems

program.zh: 国家重点研发计划课题

description.zh: 面向 E 级计算系统，开展大气动力学全隐式模拟局部求解器的移植与优化。来源记录列示执行期为2021—2023年。
description.en: Porting and optimization of local solvers for fully implicit atmospheric dynamics simulations on exascale systems. The public record lists the period as 2021–2023.

title.zh: 面向 E 级系统的并行编译优化研究
title.en: Parallel compilation optimization for exascale systems

program.zh: 国家重点研发计划课题

description.zh: 围绕 E 级系统的并行编译优化开展研究。李老师在公开项目记录中列为子课题负责人。
description.en: Research on parallel compilation optimization for exascale systems. The public record identifies Professor Li as a subtask lead.

title.zh: 粒子类问题的可扩展并行算法研究
title.en: Scalable parallel algorithms for particle problems

program.zh: 国家重点研发计划课题

description.zh: 面向粒子类科学计算问题，研究并行算法的可扩展性。来源记录列示执行期为2017—2020年。
description.en: Research on scalable parallel algorithms for particle problems. The public record lists the period as 2017–2020.

title.zh: 核反应堆关键材料性能优化高性能数值模拟软件研发
title.en: High-performance numerical simulation software for optimizing key nuclear reactor materials

description.zh: 开展面向核反应堆关键材料的高性能数值模拟软件研究。下方计算内核论文的致谢列有该项目编号。
description.en: High-performance numerical simulation software for key nuclear reactor materials. The kernel optimization paper linked below acknowledges this grant.

title.zh: 多范例并行构件及其关键技术研究
title.en: Multi-paradigm parallel components and key technologies

program.zh: 教育部科学技术研究重点项目
program.en: Ministry of Education key research project

description.zh: 研究多范例并行构件及其关键技术，是公开记录中的教育部科学技术研究重点项目。
description.en: Research on multi-paradigm parallel components and their key technologies, recorded as a Ministry of Education key research project.

title.zh: 高生产率并行模型与编译验证
title.en: High-productivity parallel models and compilation verification

description.zh: 围绕高生产率并行模型及编译验证开展研究，是公开记录中的国家863计划项目。
description.en: Research on high-productivity parallel models and compilation verification, recorded as a National 863 Program project.
